notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Mode Router selects 'Draft Mode Iteration (360p)': rapidly iterate concepts at low-cost 360p draft resolution before committing a final take to 1080p/4K rendering → Input Prep (Nano Banana Pro pre-cleans or generates any needed reference/anchor images) → Omni Flash 1.1 executes the mode's native generation/edit call with correctly structured inputs (frameImages / referenceImages / source video as required) → World-Knowledge Consistency Critic (does the result respect physics, scene logic, and the world-knowledge grounding Omni Flash brings beyond raw photorealism?) → Repair via a follow-up Interactions-API turn (conversational edit) rather than a full regeneration when the mode supports it → Deliver at draft (360p) then promote to 1080p/4K once approved → Package.
STAGE 1 — MODE ROUTER + INPUT PREP Mode: Draft Mode Iteration (360p). Wire only the inputs this mode actually consumes — text brief, one anchor image, up to five references, or an existing clip.
STAGE 2 — INPUT PREP (NANO BANANA PRO) Pre-cleans or generates any anchor and reference frames the mode requires.
STAGE 3 — OMNI FLASH 1.1 EXECUTION The mode's native call. The text-only lane uses a prompt-only video-gen node; the reference lane conditions on the anchor; the edit lane consumes the source video.

STAGE 4 — WORLD-KNOWLEDGE CONSISTENCY CRITIC Does the result respect physics, scene logic and the world knowledge Omni Flash brings beyond raw photorealism? Repair via a follow-up edit turn, not a full regeneration.
STAGE 5 — DRAFT THEN PROMOTE Review at draft resolution, then promote the approved cut to delivery.

N-037_automotive_30s.title: Automotive Film: form, motion, arrival
N-037_automotive_30s.summary: INPUTS Product, character and world references plus the written brief.
N-037_automotive_30s.pipeline: reference-image-input → character-input → background-input → prompt → 5× text-gen → 3× video-reference → video-concat → 2× text-gen → lyria-3 → merge-audio-video → text-gen → video-subtitle → download
notes: STAGE 1 — INPUTS Product, character and world references plus the written brief. Leave any input you do not need empty.
STAGE 2 — STRATEGY Turns a loose brief into a hard campaign spine: one job, one tension, one through-line device, locked look.
STAGE 3 — THE 30s SCRIPT Written as one continuous film that happens to be cut at the 10s and 20s marks — that is what makes the three clips join invisibly.
STAGE 4 — 3 x 10s CLIPS One writer and one generator per segment. Each writer reads the whole script and extracts only its own segment, carrying the handoff frame from its neighbour.
STAGE 5 — ASSEMBLY 3 clips concatenated in order into the finished 30-second film.
